visualCharacteristics.purpose: Mailing-list signup form collecting name, email and postcode
visualCharacteristics.layout: Stacked labelled fields; first and last name side by side under a shared 'Name' legend; centered Subscribe button

contentPattern.structure: one row per field with cells Label | Type | Name | Placeholder | Required | Group; a 'submit' row whose label is the button text; optional two-cell settings rows: action (submission URL), method, success (thank-you message), error
rows: Thanks for signing up to Fair Treatment.

usage: Use for the 'Sign up to Fair Treatment' mailing-list form, placed beside default-content heading and intro text in a magenta split section.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any simple contact or signup form. Supported field types: text, email, tel, number, url, date, textarea, checkbox, select (options comma separated in the Placeholder cell), hidden, submit. Without an action row the form validates and shows the success message but does not send data.
